items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: I had my band, Baby Lane. My daddy got a band for me, and he started me out playing, so I played with my dad.

ctx.x: Well, didn't you have your own band while your daddy's was called?
Oh, yeah, and I had my band, Baby Lane. My daddy got a band for me, and he started me out playing, so I played with my dad. What instruments did you play? I played a trumpet.
Any other instruments? Well, yeah. I, yeah, yeah. I, yeah, yeah. I, yeah, yeah.
